layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Ceratopsian horn morphology
features: A dinosaur head featuring two exceptionally long, curved clay brow horns as the primary focus
The horns are made of light tan clay with realistic hand-sculpted ring textures at the base
A small, sharp clay nose horn sits above a thick parrot-like beak
The frill in the background is simple and perforated with large holes (fenestrae) to keep the focus on the horns
Earth-toned clay skin with intricate hand-pressed scale and node textures
Large, expressive brown clay eye and a gentle smile
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic profile shot of a clay ceratopsian, specifically emphasizing the impressive length and curve of the brow horns. Professional studio lighting with soft shadows on a neutral background. No text.
